current = Draft · AwaitingCurator · Active · Review (one per project)
open = AwaitingCurator · Active · Review (holds a curator, blocks a second checkpoint)
running = Active · Review (calls, verdict, admin refund)
ran = Active · Review · Closed (pages stay readable)
pending = Draft · AwaitingCurator (before day one; the author may cancel)
ended = Closed · Cancelled · unnumbered = Draft · Cancelled
acceptsEvidence = Draft · Active
checkpointMove(from, to) spread into updateMany: the expected status is in the WHERE, so two writers never both win
no other code writes status · an illegal move is refused, with a test each
found today: cron silence vs curator accept can reset an Active run to Draft
switching to AI after a decline jumps to Active without sessions or the first letter
admin refund can overwrite a just-sent verdict (Closed → Cancelled)
